en.headline: Observatory records coolest autumn morning so far at 23.2 degrees
en.dek: The Observatory recorded 23.2C at 7:40am on Monday, the lowest since autumn began, as the cold front and strong monsoon bring further cooling tonight to about 19C urban.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the temperature at its headquarters reached 23.2 degrees Celsius at 7:40am on Monday, the lowest reading so far this autumn.

Districts across the city were generally about two degrees cooler than on Sunday. A cold front had crossed the Guangdong coast, and the subsequent intense northeast monsoon was bringing strong northerly winds.

The Observatory forecast that the day would turn mainly fine and dry after a cooler morning, with a high around 26 degrees. Urban temperatures were expected to fall further to a minimum of about 19 degrees tonight, with the New Territories one or two degrees lower.

On Tuesday morning the urban minimum is forecast at about 16 degrees, again with the New Territories a couple of degrees cooler. The Strong Monsoon Signal and Red Fire Danger Warning remained in force.

zh.headline: 天文台錄得今年入秋以來最低23.2度 今晚市區約19度
zh.dek: 天文台今早7時40分錄得23.2度，為今年入秋以來最低；冷鋒及強烈季候風影響下，今晚市區最低約19度。
body: 香港天文台表示，周一早上7時40分於天文台總部錄得氣溫23.2度，是今年入秋以來的最低紀錄。
本港各區今早氣溫普遍較周日低約兩度。一道冷鋒已橫過廣東沿岸，隨後的強烈東北季候風正影響本港，吹偏北強風。
天文台預測，日間將漸轉天晴及乾燥，最高氣溫約26度。晚上市區氣溫進一步下降至最低約19度，新界再低一兩度。
周二早上市區最低約16度，新界再低一兩度。強烈季候風信號及紅色火災危險警告仍然生效。
